variants.headline: Looking back: party leader faces a challenge
variants.sub: A challenge to the leadership of {party} has opened.
variants.body:
We return to {first_reported}. Our report recorded this: The leader of {party} was being challenged.

There is a challenge to a party leader. Plenty of room for excitement; no room to print a winner who has not been established. Readers can follow the contest without being sold a finished story. The title matters, but what someone wants to do with it matters more.

The event remains part of the record. Whether subsequent developments met the standard it raised is a separate question, not something the old headline can answer by itself.

We take a favourable view of {target}. A leadership challenge does not make hostile interpretations correct, and a political position deserves support where the case against it rests on assumption.
